about: The airport is near the settlement of Chulman, 35 km from Neryungri. A branch of FKP Aeroporty Severa. Paved runway 3,600 × 45 m, terminal for 100 passengers.

terminals.title: Terminal
terminals.text: One terminal building for 100 passengers. The ticket office opens 2 hours before a scheduled flight, no lunch break. Ticket office phone +7 (4114) 77-74-60.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: ON PASS lounge on Level 2, in the departure area after security. Entry 3 hours before the flight, open to any passenger for a fee. Adult 3,500 ₽, child 2–12 years 2,500 ₽, under 2 free. Wi‑Fi, snacks, drinks. Phone +7 (906) 241-71-62.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: The mother and child room is open round the clock, free of charge. Admits children under 5 and disabled children under 14 with one adult, and women in the second half of pregnancy. Passport and ticket required. There are adult and children's beds and changing areas.
